In today's episode, we sit down with Robert J. O'Neill former SEAL Team Six operator, bestselling author, and the man who fired the shots that killed Osama bin Laden for an unforgettable conversation about fear, courage and the mindset that never quits.

Robert takes us inside the one-way mission: the goodbye letters he wrote to his daughters, the two helicopters with no backup, and what really happened on the night that changed history. He breaks down why fear actually makes you braver, the simple rule that got him through the hardest training on earth ("quit tomorrow, never today"), why your only goal should be the next meal, and the surprising price he paid for becoming the man who killed bin Laden.

Raw, intense and deeply inspiring this one will change how you face your hardest moments.

videos.title: Matthew McConaughey: Life Got Easy After I Learned This
videos.description:
You can’t keep love at 100 watts forever. But a dimmer light can last a lot longer.

In this episode, Matthew McConaughey and Jay Shetty talk about what a free day looks like when you love to work. Matthew explains why he stopped saying “midlife crisis.” And he shares the question he can’t stop asking himself since turning 50.

He tells a story from after Hurricane Katrina. An 80-year-old woman stood where her house used to be and asked him for one thing. He talks about the three people who have passed away that he still runs his big choices by. And he says why he thinks real religion is selfish.

Learn why he expects perfection from himself but tries to be happy with an 88. And learn why he believes God will say “you’re welcome.”
